annotation.title_clean: Besluit van 8 april 2019 tot wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, in verband met de aanpassing van enkele regels voor de beoordeling van verblijfsaanvragen
annotation.title_en: Decree of 8 April 2019 amending the Aliens Decree 2000, in connection with the adjustment of certain rules for assessing residence applications
annotation.summary_en: Dutch royal decree amending the Aliens Decree 2000, effective 1 May 2019. It abolishes the general discretionary power to grant residence permits, adds an ex officio assessment of compelling situations in first applications, and preserves the old basis for UK nationals after Brexit. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Abolishes the general discretionary power in Article 3.4(3) of the Aliens Decree.
Inserts Article 3.6ba allowing ex officio permits in compelling situations during the first procedure.
Allows ministerial regulation to designate categories of foreigners for humanitarian or national-interest permits.
Old Article 3.4(3) remains applicable to UK nationals in connection with Brexit.
Enters into force 1 May 2019; existing permits are respected.
